info.headline: Notify NYC - 2026 NYRR Staten Island Half - 10/11 (SI)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 03:02 PM.
As part of the 2026 NYRR Staten Island Half, there will be multiple rolling street closures in Staten Island on 10/11, at the discretion of the NYPD.
The following streets will be closed: Bay Street, Slosson Terrace, School Road, Lily Pond Avenue, Father Capodanno Boulevard, Edgewater Drive, and roads surrounding Fort Wadsworth.
Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible. Use local mass transit if possible.
